--- title: "[StepDropZeroVariance]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-class}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Remove columns that have a single unique value (zero variance). ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/tidymodels/shoez/blob/examples-section/shoez/step_drop_zero_variance.py#L60-L174){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.CLASS} ```python StepDropZeroVariance(columns, id=None) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} The selected columns whose observed values are all the same — or all missing — are dropped, and no new columns are produced. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [columns]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Selector]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Columns to consider for removal. Accepts a single column name, a list of names, a shoez selector such as ``Selectors.predictors()`` (see `Selectors` for the full set), or a narwhals or polars selector (``narwhals.selectors.numeric()``, ``polars.selectors.numeric()``). Selectors are resolved against the frame's schema when the recipe is fitted, so the same selector works on any backend. Any dtype is accepted. [id]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Stable step identifier. Default ``"zv"``. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ``const`` has a single unique value, so it is dropped; ``x`` is kept: ::: {#260e61f1 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} df = pd.DataFrame({"x": [1.0, 2.0, 3.0], "const": [5.0, 5.0, 5.0]}) df ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ```{=html}
x const
0 1.0 5.0
1 2.0 5.0
2 3.0 5.0
``` ::: ::: Specifying the step touches no data: ::: {#6cde1c78 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} recipe = Recipe().add(StepDropZeroVariance(s.numeric_predictors())) recipe ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` Recipe (untrained) Inputs: no roles assigned Steps: step_drop_zero_variance(select(role='predictor', type=NumericType)) [untrained] ``` ::: ::: `fit()` counts the unique values in each column: ::: {#a2a03a67 .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} fitted = recipe.fit(df) fitted ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ``` Recipe (trained) Inputs: 1 columns — 1 predictor Steps: step_drop_zero_variance(x, const) [trained] ``` ::: ::: `transform()` drops the constant one: ::: {#91f063b5 .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} fitted.transform(df) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=5} ```{=html}
x
0 1.0
1 2.0
2 3.0
``` ::: :::
